label: run158 netload gas endogenous
definition: (PROBE) run154 net-load West/Panhandle Waha gas-step recipe with the two-regime split frequency made ENDOGENOUS (gap G6 closed): collapse_freq derived from forecast West/Panhandle oversupply (West+Panhandle wind+solar > local load + WESTEX/PNHNDL export TTC) via fuel.ercot_west_oversupply_collapse_freq, replacing the measured Waha neg_day_freq. Validation (endogenous vs measured): 0.017/0.001/0.002 vs 0.030/0.420/0.110 for 2023/24/25 — the power-oversupply proxy tracks 2023 but is ~0 in 2024/25 because local load + the 12.68 GW takeaway absorbs all West VRE; the measured 2024 0.42 was a Permian gas-pipeline-takeaway event (no forward analogue, #12). Consequence kept per #1/#11: West CTs see firm gas ~99% of hours, so CT_PEAKER drops (2024 4.95 vs run154's measured-freq 7.20 TWh; still within the C1 band). NOT-YET (price_mean/price_shape energy-only-dual limits, inherited from run154). Demonstrates G6 closure; not a keeper.
